copy.tagline: 强制使用Solidclaw管理密钥与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要统一密钥处理方式并避免泄露
copy.tagline_en: Enforce Solidclaw-only secret handling and setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs unified secret handling to prevent leaks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会拒绝直接处理密钥或配置命令，强制引导用户通过 Solidclaw 界面或 CLI 安全存储密钥。
howto.when: 当用户询问如何设置 Telegram、Slack、Gmail 等工具或插件的认证、配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 Telegram 机器人。
say.note: Claude 会引导你使用 Solidclaw 存储令牌。

say.text: 如何配置 Gmail 的 API 密钥？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will refuse to handle secrets or configuration commands directly, and will force users to store secrets securely via Solidclaw UI or CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks how to set up authentication or configuration for tools like Telegram, Slack, Gmail, etc.

say_en.text: Help me set up a Telegram bot.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to use Solidclaw to store the token.

say_en.text: How do I configure Gmail API key?
say_en.note: Claude will refuse to provide direct commands and require Solidclaw.
